acceptedInterpretation: One unified deliverable: a cross-platform proper-lockfile mutex (fixes the two LOCK findings — live-holder age-steal and reclaim TOCTOU) plus a content-bound verifyBuildBinding skip gate and a packages/utils binding (fixes the two FRESHNESS findings — mtime misclassification and existence-only reuse), applied to the three build call sites. Explicitly NOT atomic-publish / symlink dist-swap (YAGNI; Windows symlink perms fragile).
notes: Multi-deliverable (lock + freshness) but coherent: both classes are the shared-worktree concurrent-build hazard, resolved as one content-bound-idempotent-build-with-cross-platform-mutex change. Maintainer approved this exact design in-session.
